data.current_summary: Find an app's competitors (apps ranking for the same keywords plus the store's "similar apps").
data.current_description:
Scored list, best first. Keyword overlap counts most and is weighted by rank on both sides (sharing a top-10
term counts far more than both sitting at #30 for a generic one) and by how specific the other app is
(apps that rank in many more keyword universes than this one, such as social or video giants, are
down-weighted). The store's own similar-apps list (`similar_position`) adds a boost. Apps in an unrelated
category are penalised (adjacent ones such as Health & Fitness and Medical are not), games never match
non-games, and apps that only come from the similar list must sit at its very top. Apps by the same
developer are left out unless `same_developer=true`. An app that isn't in the catalog yet is fetched from
the store first (`wait`, as on `getApp`); if the fetch is still running the answer is 202 with an empty list
and `meta.freshness.job_id`. Feed the result into `getApp` / `listAppChanges` for a competitor digest.

Competitors are identified through keyword overlap (weighted by rank specificity) and the store's similar-apps list. Scoring factors include: keyword overlap strength (top-10 matches weighted higher than generic terms), app specificity (social/video giants down-weighted), category relevance (unrelated categories penalized, adjacent categories allowed), and store similarity boost. Games never match non-games. Apps by the same developer are excluded by default; pass `same_developer=true` to include them. If the app is not yet in the catalog, it is fetched from the store first (async with `wait` parameter; HTTP 202 with empty list and `job_id` if still fetching). Returns scored list best-first. Combine with `getApp` or `listAppChanges` for competitive analysis.

data.current_description:
Scored list, best first. Keyword overlap counts most and is weighted by rank on both sides (sharing a top-10
term counts far more than both sitting at #30 for a generic one) and by how specific the other app is
